description: This file contains implementation of the TestConnectJobDelegate class, which is used for testing connection jobs in the net namespace. It manages callbacks, socket handling, and synchronization for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestConnectJobDelegate
classes.description: A test delegate class for handling connection job callbacks, socket management, and synchronization in tests.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a connect job, checks results, and signals the run loop.

methods.name: OnNeedsProxyAuth
methods.description: Handles proxy authentication challenges during connection.

methods.name: WaitForAuthChallenge
methods.description: Waits until a specified number of proxy auth challenges have been received.

methods.name: RunAuthCallback
methods.description: Runs the stored authentication restart callback.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Runs the main loop until a result is available and returns it.

methods.name: StartJobExpectingResult
methods.description: Starts a connect job and expects a specific result, checking synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases ownership of the socket managed by the delegate.
